notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. 
Phase changes: 942 K, $\alpha - \beta$ transition point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.667$ kcal/mol. 
1049 K, $\beta - \gamma$ transition point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 1.137$ kcal/mol. 
1408 K, melting point of U; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.185$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 14.800 + 0.066 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.946 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{\circ}-H_{298}^{\circ}=14.800\times10^{-3}T+0.033\times10^{-6}T^{2}+0.946\times10^{2}T^{-1}-4.733$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-942 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -10.289 + 3.347 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 4.509 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 113.800 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -10.289 - 3.347 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 4.509 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 56.900 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 18.244 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
942-1049 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -7.879 - 3.798 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.287 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 26.300 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -7.879 + 3.798 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.287 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 13.150 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 29.217 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1049-1408 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -10.175 - 2.693 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.287 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 26.300 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -10.175 + 2.693 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.287 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 13.150 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 19.342 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1408-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -8.868 - 5.173 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 0.287 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 26.300 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -8.868 + 5.173 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 0.287 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 13.150 \mathrm{T}^{-1} - 38.250 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Source: Data from Gronvold (47) who estimated all except enthalpy of formation at 298 K.
